test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. 

A. Telugu movie industry is proud of many great producers, directors, artists and musicians.

B. Savithri was one such great artist who influenced Telegu movie industry single-handedly for many years.

C. Her initial interest was in dance so she learnt dance before entering movies.

D. She is still worshipped for her matchless expressions and dialogue delivery.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (2)** i.e. **ABCD**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The paragraph starts with a general introduction to the Telugu movie industry and its pride in many great contributors, indicated by **part (A)**.
 
• Next, **part (B)** introduces Savithri as one of the great artists who made a significant impact on the industry.
 
• **Part (C)** provides insight into her early interest in dance, which is an important foundation of her career in the film industry.
 
• **Finally, part (D)** highlights her lasting legacy, describing how she is still revered for her exceptional expressions and dialogue delivery.

Therefore, the correct answer is **ABCD.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (DCAB):** This sequence begins with her dance background and jumps to other points too abruptly without building a logical flow about her legacy and impact.
 
• **Option 3 (BCDA):** This sequence begins by directly introducing Savithri, skipping the broader context of the Telugu movie industry’s pride in its great talents, which weakens the introduction.
 
• **Option 4 (ACDB):** This sequence starts with her dance background but doesn’t properly introduce her as a significant figure in the Telugu movie industry, weakening the context of her contribution.
